failure_modes: Reading constant change as progress when it only holds position
Assuming a dominant strategy exists and can be found once
gloss: In co-evolving niches, adapting keeps you in place rather than moving you ahead
invariants: The niche changes because of the occupants' own adaptations, not only from outside
Stopping adaptation lowers relative fitness even if absolute performance is unchanged
mechanism: Predators, prey, parasites, competitors and pathogens adapt to one another at the same time. Each adaptation changes the niche the others occupy, so fitness gained by one party is cancelled by the others' response. Extinction risk stays roughly constant over time: no strategy wins permanently, though better and worse strategies still exist.
